purpose: Part L — permanent coach-currency refresh architecture (design only; not built). Programme-page-keyed, not coach-search-keyed.
keying: One current official staff-page fetch resolves every coach at that (institution,sport). Measured efficiency across Phases 4A-4D: ~5-8 coaches per page. Refresh iterates programmes, not coaches.

cadence.pre_season: Full re-verify of all outreach-eligible programmes Jul-Sep (2026-27 staff finalize); this is the authoritative annual pass.
cadence.mid_season: Oct-Nov spot pass over programmes whose evidence is >season-old or that changed.
cadence.spring: Jan-Feb lighter pass for spring hires/departures.

evidence_expiry: currentness_checked_at older than one competitive season (=1 year) marks the CHECK stale (needs re-verification) — distinct from the COACH being PROVEN_STALE. Eligibility is unaffected by a stale check; it lowers confidence and reprioritizes the programme for the next pass.
page_unavailable: currentness stays at its prior value (or UNKNOWN); never set PROVEN_STALE from an unreachable page. Retry with backoff; try secondary authoritative source (institution directory, conference). Record reason SITE_BLOCKED.
person_absent: Absent from a reachable current page => provisional; require a SECOND authoritative source (or a named replacement in the role) before PROVEN_STALE. Single-source unexplained absence => UNKNOWN (PERSON_ABSENT_BUT_NOT_PROVEN_DEPARTED).
second_source_before_proven_stale: Required whenever the only signal is absence. A named replacement in the same role on the official page counts as corroboration.
moved_coaches: Set currentness PROVEN_STALE at the old programme + record destination in currentness_reason; retain the historical row. A new row at the new institution is a separate acquisition, not a mutation of the old.
email_observation: On each pass, if the exact stored address is on the current page, set email_seen_on_source_at/_url (Part G). If a different address is published, queue a DIFFERENT_CURRENT_EMAIL correction. Never touch email_confirmed_at (deliverability only).
historical_retention: Never delete a departed coach's identity or evidence; PROVEN_STALE + evidence preserves history. Only true duplicates are removed.
coach_seasons_relationship: coach_seasons (yearly roster scrape) may CORROBORATE currency positively; its ABSENCE is never sole negative evidence (assistants routinely unscraped). It can prioritize which programmes to re-fetch.
outreach_eligibility_relationship: PROVEN_STALE fails eligibility CLOSED (already implemented). CURRENT is highest confidence. UNKNOWN remains eligible (fail-open) but flagged lower-confidence and surfaced for verification before a campaign.
unknown_behaviour: UNKNOWN is a legitimate steady state (esp. SITE_BLOCKED, IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS). It is never auto-promoted to CURRENT or auto-demoted to STALE; it is re-attempted each pass and via secondary sources.
